description.zh:
* 指定识别的PDF/OFD页码；例如：pageNo=6，识别PDF/OFD的第六页。
* 如果该参数为空，或传值大于PDF/OFD总页数，则识别PDF/OFD的第一页。
* 如果使用SDK设置此参数，请更新SDK版本，该参数在SDK版本1.1.16开始支持。
description.en:
* Specifies the page number of the PDF/OFD file to be recognized; for example, pageNo=6 recognizes the sixth page of the PDF/OFD file.  
* If this parameter is empty or its value exceeds the total number of pages in the PDF/OFD file, the first page is recognized.  
* If you use a software development kit (SDK) to set this parameter, update your SDK version. This parameter is supported starting from SDK Version 1.1.16.

description.zh:
* 本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）。
description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you must specify one and only one.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length and does not support Base64 encoding).

description.zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可。
description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you must specify one and only one.  
* Binary image file, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body.  
* When using an SDK, place the image in the SDK's body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云增值税发票识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，适用于识别增值税发票上所包含的价税合计、发票代码、发票号码等关键信息的场景。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像自动旋转、畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |高精度识别|总体识别准确率可达98%。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [票据凭证识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=bill&subtype=invoice#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[增值税发票识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_invoice_dp_cn_20211103182712_0783%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。您也可以不购买资源包，系统会通过“[按量付费](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html)”方式按实际调用量自动扣款。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeInvoice?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| ------ #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP、PDF、OFD。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |相关能力|
  • [云市场增值税发票识别。](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi027758.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.1ff64dcdDsX9s8#sku=yuncode2175800000)
| |其他说明|
  • 接口未训练版型会影响输出结果
  • 比如：超长单价、超长行列等
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud VAT Invoice Recognition is an OCR product independently developed by Alibaba Cloud. It is suitable for scenarios that require extracting key information from VAT invoices, such as the total amount including tax, invoice code, and invoice number. * Powered by DAMO Academy's advanced AI technologies and vast data resources, Alibaba Cloud's OCR products have been refined over years of development and offer advantages including stable service, ease of use, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Categorization | Overview | |---|---------| | Image Enhancement | Supports image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Broad Coverage of Types | Supports recognition of low-quality images, such as blurry images, images with uneven lighting, perspective distortion, or arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-Accuracy Recognition | Achieves an overall recognition accuracy rate of up to 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Bill and Credential Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=bill&subtype=invoice#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [VAT Invoice Recognition Resource Plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_invoice_dp_cn_20211103182712_0783%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API provides a free quota for testing purposes. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; in this case, the system will automatically deduct fees based on actual usage under the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing model. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeInvoice?sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API into your application. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For detailed steps on granting permissions, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | ------ #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports the following formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, WebP, PDF, and OFD.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (height-to-width or width-to-height) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve optimal recognition results, we recommend that both dimensions exceed 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Larger images may affect API response speed. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Related Capabilities |
  • [VAT Invoice Recognition on Alibaba Cloud Marketplace](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi027758.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.1ff64dcdDsX9s8#sku=yuncode2175800000).
|
